item.title: Supreme Court to Hear Apple‑Epic Games Contempt Case
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court will hear Apple’s appeal over Epic Games’ civil contempt ruling on App Store payment rules, a pivotal moment for digital commerce.

item.title: Apple Could Lose Commission on Third‑Party App Sales
item.description: Apple’s filing admits it may earn zero commission from apps sold via alternative stores, igniting fresh legal battles and reshaping the app economy.
